system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
# PROJECT KESTREL — BUYER SIDE MARK-UP & PUSH-BACK MEMO  
**Prepared for:** Wattlebridge Holdings deal team (Principal: Amelia Frost)  
**Date:** 23 September 2026  
**Classification:** PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL — LEGAL ADVICE  

---

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The Seller’s “final” package **departs from our playbook on every material lever**: cap, thresholds, time limits, fundamental warranties, fraud carve-outs, disclosure, buyer-knowledge, Bluefen, Riverlark, employee bonuses, Ironquay, title evidence, and the Tax/IP regime. The Seller also attempts to **pre-clock the review** by labelling all contested clauses “[STANDARD]” and “cleared by both sides”. **No written authority from Amelia Frost exists for any fallback position.** We must reject the “final” framing, reopen every [STANDARD] item, and issue a comprehensive counter-mark.

---

## CLAUSE-BY-CLAUSE DEPARTURES & REQUIRED PUSH-BACK

| # | Playbook Position | Seller’s Position | Departure Severity | Required Push-Back & Reasoning |
|---|-------------------|-------------------|-------------------|--------------------------------|
| **1** | **General cap: 25% / AUD 6M** (starting). 20% / AUD 4.8M **only with Amelia Frost written authority** (none given). | 20% / AUD 4.8M, marked “[STANDARD] … FINAL”. | **CRITICAL** | **Reject cap.** No principal sign-off for fallback. Counter at 25% / AUD 6M. Reserve right to move to 20% only if Frost provides written authority *on a specific draft*. |
| **2** | **De minimis AUD 5k; basket AUD 50k, first-dollar recovery once exceeded.** | De minimis AUD 25k; basket AUD 250k, **excess-only recovery**. | **CRITICAL** | **Reject thresholds.** Seller’s basket = 1.04% of price (market ≠ our mandate). First-dollar recovery is non-negotiable. Counter at playbook figures. |
| **3** | **General claims period: 24 months.** 18 months only with Frost written approval (none). | 18 months, “any limitation applies to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise”. | **CRITICAL** | **Reject 18 months.** Counter at 24 months. The “applies to all Claims” language is a covert attempt to collapse fundamental/title claims into the general regime — **strike it**. |
| **4** | **Fundamental/Title: separate regime, 100% cap, ≥6 years, outside general basket/de minimis/knowledge bar.** | Capacity & title warranties subject to **same caps & time limits as general warranties** “for administrative simplicity”. | **CRITICAL** | **Reject entirely.** Fundamental warranties must sit in a standalone schedule with 100% cap, 6+ year limitation, no basket/de minimis/knowledge qualification. |
| **5** | **Fraud, wilful concealment, deliberate misconduct: carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance.** | Limitations, exclusive-remedy, non-reliance apply to **“all Claims of any nature”**. | **CRITICAL** | **Insert express fraud/wilful misconduct carve-out** in caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance clauses. No one may waive this. |
| **6** | **Disclosure: specific fair disclosure only. Reject whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure.** | General disclosure of **entire data room (DD-002–DD-012) + public registers + statutory registers**. | **CRITICAL** | **Strike general disclosure.** Require specific, paragraph-by-paragraph fair disclosure against each warranty. Data-room dump is unenforceable for fair-disclosure purposes under NSW law. |
| **7** | **Buyer knowledge: delete blanket exclusions. Any qualifier needs named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry. Never excuses title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity.** | “Buyer shall have no claim in respect of any matter of which the Buyer or its advisers had knowledge, **including any matter discoverable from the data room or public records**.” | **CRITICAL** | **Delete clause 8.3.** Replace with: (a) no buyer-knowledge bar for title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnities; (b) for other warranties, only actual knowledge of **named Buyer individuals** (list to be agreed) after reasonable enquiry. |
| **8** | **Bluefen: effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied BEFORE Completion. Reasonable endeavours alone insufficient.** | “Reasonable endeavours … consent treated as satisfied on delivery of counterparty’s written consent.” | **HIGH** | **Redraft condition precedent:** (i) Bluefen written consent **in form and substance acceptable to Buyer**; (ii) **evidence all clause 11.3 conditions satisfied**; (iii) **no “reasonable endeavours” qualifier** — absolute obligation. |
| **9** | **Riverlark: current payout, direct repayment from Completion funds, effective security releases. Post-completion release needs irrevocable undertaking + Frost approval.** | “Release to be provided **following Completion**.” | **HIGH** | **Require payoff at Completion from purchase price.** If Seller insists on post-completion release: (a) irrevocable undertaking from Riverlark; (b) escrow of AUD 3.2M + margin; (c) **Frost written approval mandatory**. |
| **10** | **Employee bonuses (DD-005): AUD 420k + on-costs as specific line item or seller-funded. Funds flow must not silently exclude them.** | “Matter for the Seller … **not separately itemised in the funds flow**.” | **HIGH** | **Insert dedicated line item** in completion funds flow for AUD 420k + payroll tax, super, on-costs (gross-up). Alternatively, Seller funds via separate side letter. Silence = price adjustment risk. |
| **11** | **Ironquay IP: broaden narrow indemnity, preserve SOW3 cure. AUD 180k not independently verified.** | Existing indemnity **limited to SOW3 payment only**, “considered adequate”. | **MODERATE-HIGH** | **Broaden indemnity** to cover: (a) any IP infringement claim arising from Ironquay deliverables; (b) failure to transfer Project Materials on cleared payment; (c) preserve SOW3 cure right. **Demand independent bank confirmation** of AUD 180k status. |
| **12** | **Export/privacy (DD-006): preserve logs, investigate, require updates. Assume NO confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or numeric demand.** | “Preliminary operational matter … **not expected to be material**.” | **MODERATE** | **Accept “preliminary” framing but lock in:** (a) preservation of all logs/evidence; (b) Seller to provide fortnightly investigation updates until Completion + 6 months post; (c) specific indemnity for any resulting regulatory fines, notification costs, third-party claims. No admission of materiality either way. |
| **13** | **Sandbar renewals (AUD 330k): assess; no automatic Debt classification or price deduction.** | “Ordinary-course operating costs.” | **LOW-MODERATE** | **Reserve right to assess.** Require disclosure of: (i) termination provisions; (ii) accrual status at Completion; (iii) whether any change-of-control consent needed. No auto-deduction, but no free pass. |
| **14** | **Tax/IP: keep separate; assume no unlimited liability and no resolution.** | “Settled under the general regime above.” | **HIGH** | **Reject fold-in.** Tax and IP warranties must have **standalone caps, time limits, and carve-outs** (Tax: 100% cap, 7+ years; IP: 100% cap, 6+ years). No “general regime” override. |
| **15** | **Title: independent evidence of ownership/encumbrance/authority. DD-012 register = internal source, not independent proof.** | “Title … evidenced by the Company share register at DD-012.” | **CRITICAL** | **Require:** (a) ASIC historical extract; (b) share certificates or uncertificated holding statements; (c) director/resolution evidence of authority to sell; (d) PPSR/searches for encumbrances. DD-012 is **not sufficient**. |
| **16** | **Reviewer Efficiency Note: “[STANDARD] clauses cleared by both sides … final … not intended to be re-opened”.** | Tactically framed to **narrow review scope**. | **PROCESS** | **Formally reject the “pre-cleared” narrative.** No clause is closed without Frost principal sign-off. Issue full mark-up on every contested clause. |

---

## DISCLOSURE LETTER — SPECIFIC RED FLAGS CONFIRMING OUR CONCERNS

| Disclosure Ref. | Seller’s Disclosure | Playbook Risk Confirmed |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------------------|
| **2 (Bluefen)** | “Seller has **NOT included a final written Bluefen consent or evidence that associated conditions have been satisfied**.” | Condition precedent **not satisfied** — Completion cannot occur without it
=== END ADVICE ===
